body.expected_draft_revision: integer >= 0 or null; OPTIONAL (additive, compatible with existing callers). When sent, it must equal the draft revision at publish time (checked inside the row lock) or the publish is rejected.

success.notes: source_draft_revision = the draft revision the immutable version was captured from (null for versions published before S01d).

guarantees: no version is created and the draft is untouched
the draft row is locked during publish, so a concurrent save cannot slip a schema in between validation and capture; the captured schema always corresponds to source_draft_revision
